<thought>Search the template catalog for all templates that break a ketone (functional group “ketones”). Then I will examine the returned templates to find one whose mapped reaction converts a carbonyl‑containing precursor into a simple alkane, which corresponds to the Wolff‑Kishner reduction. I will request a larger result set to increase the chance of finding the correct template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(=O)C",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones"],
    "limit": 100
}
</action_input>
